questions.question: What does SCAN results in a plan mean?
options: SQLite reads every row in the table.
questions.explanation: A scan reads the whole table. With an index the plan says SEARCH ... USING INDEX.

questions.question: Why is the index on (outcome, checked_at) and not (checked_at, outcome)?
options: The query filters by outcome, then sorts by time, and indexes are used left to right
questions.explanation: The leftmost column serves the equality filter; the next one provides the order, so no separate sort is needed.

questions.question: What is the main cost of adding an index?
options: The table can no longer be queried.
Every write must also update the index, and it takes space.
questions.explanation: Indexes speed up matching reads at the cost of extra work on every write and extra storage.
